wholeCurrentGoal.title: Kreuzungsexperimente statistisch auswerten
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Kreuzungsexperimente auswerten, um den statistischen Charakter der Vererbung abzuleiten.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can evaluate crossing experiments to infer the statistical nature of inheritance.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: The small tray contains exactly six yellow and two green seeds (8 total); the large tray has four rows of seven yellow plus three green (28+12=40). The shown 28:12 yields 70%:30%, while the expected frequencies are 75%:25%. Thus the count pictures agree with the table and distinguish a model expectation from a realised sample. The dice/thought bubble supports stochastic interpretation, not a deterministic claim that each sample must be exactly3:1.
rows.actualReadability: At360 the table headings, all four percentages, 28:12, the two sample sizes and contrasting coloured groups remain readable/countable; at680 and original all40 seeds are individually distinct. Tiny background poster is optional, not required to decode the example.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: The illustrated learner faces the analysis/table from the side and the pen reaches a foreshortened notebook with generic marks; no false real dataset or performed crossing is shown. The expectation is conditional on a relevant Mendelian model and sampling assumptions; no significance test, convergence guarantee or sample execution is evidenced.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Mono- und dihybride Erbgänge vorhersagen
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Genotypen- und Phänotypenverteilungen bei Kreuzungen vorhersagen, indem sie Gesetzmäßigkeiten der Vererbung auf mono- und dihybride Erbgänge anwendet.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can predict genotype and phenotype distributions in crosses by applying inheritance laws to monohybrid and dihybrid inheritance patterns.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: Left Aa×Aa with gametes A/a gives exactly AA,Aa,Aa,aa in a2×2 grid, hence genotype1:2:1. Right AaBb×AaBb shows AB,Ab,aB,ab for EACH parent and a large independent-assortment label leading to four phenotypic classes9:3:3:1. The selected image contains no4×4 dihybrid table; the visible gamete-strip and phenotype arrangement is coherent under independent assortment, equal gamete probabilities and complete dominance.
rows.actualReadability: Both cross labels, all four gametes per parent, the monohybrid grid, Unabhängig and9:3:3:1 remain readable at360. Colour/shape phenotypes remain distinct; the longer phenotype labels are most comfortable at680/original.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: Flat symbolic genetics comparison with comic plants, not an observed sample or complete linked-gene rule. The A/a flower-colour example on the left is separate from the right two-trait colour/shape example. Independence and dominance conditions remain required; the ratio is not universal. The whole DE case correction previously independently reviewed is unchanged by this image.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Epigenetische Vererbung durch Umweltbedingungen erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Epigenetic Inheritance Through Environmental Conditions
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann den direkten Einfluss von Umweltbedingungen auf die Genaktivität der nächsten Generation als Folge epigenetischer Regulationsmechanismen erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain direct effects of environmental conditions on gene activity in the next generation as a consequence of epigenetic regulatory mechanisms.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: Environmental icons feed regulatory marks rather than a DNA-sequence edit. Two enlarged represented DNA regions have the same abstract sequence geometry with red marks and reduced expression symbols. The parent-to-next-generation relation is dotted and carries a question mark, keeping transmission conditional. This can illustrate inheritance of regulatory state at a represented locus without a forced new mutation or universally proven transmission.
rows.actualReadability: Umwelt/Genaktivität/Gleiche DNA and parent/next-generation labels, the red marks, expression contrast and question-marked dotted relation are discernible at360. The transfer wording is small at360 but readable at680/original; uncertainty is already conveyed by the large question mark.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: The same-DNA statement must be read as unchanged sequence at the depicted regulatory region/model, not identical complete parental/offspring genomes in sexual reproduction. This is a bounded model, not proof of transgenerational inheritance in a real mouse pedigree or proof that exercise/nutrition effects necessarily pass to descendants. Reprogramming, exposure controls and causal alternatives remain actual science/P duties.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Wissenswandel zu Vererbungsgesetzen erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Knowledge Change About Inheritance Laws
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann am Beispiel der Aufdeckung von Gesetzmäßigkeiten der Vererbung die Veränderung biologischen Wissens und die Bedeutung neuer Erkenntnisse für die Erklärung biologischer Phänomene beschreiben.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can use the discovery of inheritance laws to describe how biological knowledge changes and how new findings matter for explaining biological phenomena.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: Three large columns separate a blending prediction, a new discrete-inheritance observation (uniform F1 purple, F2 three purple/one white icons), and a modern segregation/recombination explanation. Discrete alleles/chromosome-origin symbols remain separate through gamete formation and one fertilisation example. The return of the recessive phenotype is mechanistically inconsistent with permanent blending.
rows.actualReadability: The three column headings, contrasted flower outcomes and segregation/reunion icons survive360; the secondary explanatory sentences are readable at680/original. The broad new-evidence-to-explanation arrow remains clear.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: A modern learner studies hypothetical model boards; this does not depict Mendel identifying chromosomes/DNA or a dated historical laboratory experiment. The right-hand diagram is one possible gamete combination, not the completeF2 distribution. Observation can refine explanations; the image does not claim that every historical blending idea or every trait had this exact trajectory.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Proteinaufgaben und Genwirkketten für Merkmale erklären
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Explain Protein Functions and Gene Chains for Traits
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann Aufgaben von Proteinen sowie das Zusammenwirken von Genen in einer Genwirkkette bei der Ausbildung von Merkmalen erläutern.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can explain protein functions and the interaction of genes in a gene chain during trait formation.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: GenA points to enzymeE1 and GenB independently points toE2. E1 points to S→I andE2 toI→P; S/I are colourless, P blue and related to a blue flower. The proteins/traits chain separates information arrows from substrate conversion, and two side motifs show structural fibres and membrane-channel transport. No broken-step/rescue requirement is injected into this GA goal.
rows.actualReadability: Genes/Proteine/Merkmal, both gene cards, E1/E2/S/I/P and structural/transport headings remain visible at360. The short function explanations are comfortable at680/original, with supporting fibre/channel shapes visible on phone.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: Globular protein cartoons, rounded substance nodes and generic channel cargo are schematic, not a chemically resolved ligand/atomic or molecule-balanced reaction. The image presents one two-enzyme chain and additional nonenzyme functions, without claiming that every protein is an enzyme or every gene/trait follows a one-gene rule.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: DNA-Replikation und PCR als natürliche und technische Prozesse vergleichen
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Compare DNA Replication and PCR as Natural and Technical Processes
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann die natürliche DNA-Replikation mit der Polymerase-Kettenreaktion vergleichen und an diesem Beispiel Probleme und Lösungen der technischen Umsetzung natürlicher Prozesse erklären.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can compare natural DNA replication with polymerase chain reaction and use this example to explain problems and solutions in the technical implementation of natural processes.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: Natural replication is in the cell with helicase, opposite nascent-strand extensions and primers. PCR is a separate thermal cycle with heat/cool/extend stages; primers occupy different templates and point inward toward the intervening target, with multiple DNA-section copies below. This preserves template-dependent antiparallel extension and distinguishes cell copying from target amplification.
rows.actualReadability: Replikation/PCR, Vorlage/Primer, the inward PCR arrows and thermal-cycle structure remain visible at360; small detailed cycle text and enzyme labels are clearer at680/original. No sequence strings or unreadable numerical quota is needed for the main comparison.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: Flat DNA-ladder model and device front view with no operating actor. Colour bars are schematic nucleotide cues without a sequence legend; they are not a validated base-resolved target sequence. Heat replaces enzymatic separation for PCR; standard thermocycling/polymerase accuracy and real experiment performance remain P/source tasks. No repair mandate is added to the GA image.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.

wholeCurrentGoal.title: Genommutationen aus Karyogrammen ableiten und Folgen unterscheiden
wholeCurrentGoal.titleEn: Infer Genome Mutations from Karyograms and Distinguish Consequences
wholeCurrentGoal.description: Die lernende Person kann aus Karyogrammen verschiedene Typen von Genommutationen ableiten, Auswirkungen auf das Lebewesen beschreiben und zwischen Genotypänderung, Phänotypänderung und Krankheit unterscheiden.
wholeCurrentGoal.descriptionEn: The learner can infer different types of genome mutations from karyograms, describe effects on the organism, and distinguish genotype change, phenotype change, and disease.

rows.scientificMechanismAndGeometry: The explicitly incomplete karyogram-model row has two copies of each of three chromosome types, trisomy only inType3 (2,2,3), and three copies of all types for the polyploid example(3,3,3). The genotype/phenotype/disease panels are separated beneath a large question mark, and further-evidence icons are shown rather than an inevitable diagnosis.
rows.actualReadability: The three model headings and2x/3x counts remain readable/countable at360. The long genotype/phenotype labels are small but distinguishable at360 and clear at680/original; the large question mark and further-evidence panel survive.
rows.actorPerspectiveAndScopeLimits: The learner looks at an upright model board; the notebook has generic nonsemantic lines and the pen is at the chin, not falsely used on a backwards labelled instrument. Each chromosome is a countable simplified rod, not a complete46-chromosome human karyotype. Polyploid/trisomy states are distinct from a clinical conclusion; the word Normal refers to the model comparison, not a person.
rows.wholeGoalFit: A bounded explanation aid for the whole current bilingual goal, not a full mastery assessment or completed practical experiment.
